subject: Inconsistent detailing of the backflow preventer assembly at Room 214 between Sheet P-601

messages.text: The backflow preventer assembly shown in Sheet P-601 at Room 214 is not detailed consistently with Plumbing Riser Diagram P-501. This is becoming a priority as rough-in proceeds. There may be a cost impact if rerouting or additional material is required. This could affect the rough-in inspection schedule. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving.
